mapper.select: SELECT MIN(rm.`role_id`) AS role_id, rm.`member_id`, MIN(rm.`member_name`) AS member_name, MIN(rm.`created_at`) AS created_at, MIN(rm.`created_by`) AS created_by FROM `role_member` rm JOIN `role` r ON r.`role_id` = rm.`role_id` AND r.`is_deleted` = 0 GROUP BY rm.`member_id` ORDER BY rm.`member_id` LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rm.`member_id`) FROM `role_member` rm JOIN `role` r ON r.`role_id` = rm.`role_id` AND r.`is_deleted` = 0

SELECT rm.`role_id`, rm.`member_id`, rm.`member_name`, rm.`created_at`, rm.`created_by` FROM `role_member` rm JOIN `role` r ON r.`role_id` = rm.`role_id` AND r.`is_deleted` = 0 WHERE rm.`member_id` = #{memberId} ORDER BY rm.`role_id`

SELECT rm.`role_id`, rm.`member_id`, rm.`member_name`, rm.`created_at`, rm.`created_by` FROM `role_member` rm JOIN `role` r ON r.`role_id` = rm.`role_id` AND r.`is_deleted` = 0 WHERE rm.`role_id` = #{roleId} ORDER BY rm.`member_id`
